market.summary: Large centralized public-library sector plus university, municipal, national/archive and specialist research libraries. Koha has the strongest evidenced nationwide public-network leverage. University discovery is heterogeneous; Yordam, Koha, SirsiDynix Enterprise-style routes, Innovative-style catalogs and Alma/Primo occur. No national LMS market-share estimate is established.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize an authorized KYGM network connection and TO-KAT agreement for breadth; neither is currently open to this automated research. Start technical exploration with verified Yordam and a small Koha reserve. Yordam needs a new adapter and institutional delay/challenge handling. Union metadata supports discovery, not current circulation or universal borrowing.

limitations: Ten major priorities are not a national largest-ten ranking. Dates, materials, records and format coverage differ.
Target of ten selected substantial institutions not reached. Broad blocked sampling retained; a small successful reserve is not padded into the selected count.
No union result or union-member holding was obtained; no branch double-counting.
No app integration, live adapter test, login, hold, outreach, TLS bypass or challenge bypass was performed.

One procedural lapse: the initial Millet homepage immediately followed its robots fetch before the newly discovered 300-second delay was enforced. The actual title query followed the homepage by more than 307 seconds. Helper was corrected to defer delayed origins.
ISPARTA size source is indexed official evidence only because live source robots failed.
Many HTTP503 responses report upstream connection timeout and may be environment/transient failures; none imply an absent book or permanent inaccessible institution.
